# Tabs
Atlas Tabs v1 — single tab item. 4 treatments (line · pill · segmented · outline) × 3 sizes × 5 states (60 total), plus Icon (boolean + instance-swap slot, default off) and Badge (boolean, default off) — mirrors the code-only leadingIcon/badge props that already shipped. Compose multiple instances inside a TabList container. See the Examples — Vertical frame on this page for orientation=&quot;vertical&quot; usage (layout-only, no separate variant).

Animated (boolean, default off): mirrors the code `animated` prop on TabsRoot. It changes no drawn state — the highlight behind the selected tab slides between triggers (pill, segmented, outline; line already slides) and the incoming panel fades in and rises by spacing/1, using duration/base and easing/emphasized. Reduced motion switches both off. The motion is documented on the Animated components page.

USE WHEN
· Two to five peer views of the same subject, or a segmented choice between named options.

DON'T USE WHEN
· The views are steps in a sequence → a flow.
· The choice navigates between routes → NavBar.

DO
· Keep panel content the same shape across tabs so the page does not jump.
· Use the Badge property for counts.

DON'T
· Build a segmented control out of plain buttons; use Variant=segmented.
· Hide a required form field behind an unselected tab.

PROPERTIES
Variant: line | pill | segmented | outline. Size: sm | md | lg. State: default | hover | focus-visible | selected | disabled. Icon, Badge, Animated: booleans.
